reader.requirement: At --std 85, FUNCTION ORD-MIN returns the ordinal (1-based position in the argument-1 series as expanded, ALL subscripts left to right within the ODO range) of the argument-1 having the least value, for numeric arguments of any usage, scale, sign and form (identifier, literal, arithmetic expression) and for nonnumeric arguments (alphanumeric, alphabetic, group, edited items, figurative constants). The witness covers literal and identifier lists of numeric and alphanumeric class only.

reader.notes: The renderer routes numeric lists to OrdMinAt with each argument at its own scale (RawArgPairs, no alignment), string lists to OrdMinString with the PCS weights when one is in effect, and wide or standard-decimal lists to the Wide/Dec/Exact bodies; each returns index+1. The ODO object bounds the ALL expansion at run time (A2).
